assertions.assertion: The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has mitral valve insufficiency
The patient reports recent episodes of transient neurological deficits suggestive of a transient ischemic attack
A 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered for continuous rhythm assessment
The Holter monitor is intended to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias
The Holter monitor is intended to assess embolic risk
The 48-hour Holter monitoring study is CPT code 93226
The 48-hour Holter monitoring study is medically necessary to support this evaluation
